lis3dhBegin.summary: Verifies and configures a LIS3DH with an explicit I2C address and acceleration range.
lis3dhBegin.returns: Boolean success; initialize before reading vectors.
prerequisites: Import Inertial Sensors and its declared dependencies.
Wire the named sensor to a configured I2C bus, use its actual addresses, and initialize it before reading. Hardware acceptance remains pending.
inputs: 1. LIS3DH begin address: number; library example 24.

examples.title: Use LIS3DH begin address … range g …
examples.explanation: Block notation: Verifies and configures a LIS3DH with an explicit I2C address and acceleration range. Boolean success; initialize before reading vectors.

notes: Portable I2C LIS3DH and LSM9DS1 helpers. Explicit initialization; no probing on import. BDU and six-byte reads, integer signed units. No orientation/fusion or calibration claim. Hardware acceptance pending.
